sources.note: Main website (Wix-based, did not render via WebFetch). Search snippet confirmed company is a web-based EHR provider for ambulatory practices.

Products page. Lists Cyfluent EHR (supporting EHR, PHR, PM, EDI, Interoperability, Interfaces, PCMH, ACO, Imaging) with named sub-products CyMED, CyPORTAL, CyCHART, CyCLAIMS, Telehealth. Also lists Cyfluent Practice Management.

Services page. Five major service areas: EHR (Patient Management, Telehealth, Clinic Processes, Patient Records/Mobile Interoperability, Labs/Prescriptions, Custom Forms Builder), Practice Management (Scheduling, Medical Billing, Medical Resource Management), Occupational Health (OSHA compliance, injury/illness records, hearing exams, fatality notification, workplace records), Health Services Management (Medical Evacuation, Mental Health/Substance Abuse, Travel Clearance, Travel Immunization), Pharmacy Fulfillment (Shipping, Inventory, Barcodes). Confirms PSI ownership, 150+ clinics, HRSA Hansen's Disease deployment, Azure FedRAMP, EHNAC accreditation.

EHR detail page. Detailed descriptions of Patient Management (allergies, prescriptions, problems, health history, family history, personal habits, contacts, alerts, body measurements, vitals, encounters, vision, quality indicators), Clinic Processes (CPOE, templates, chronic disease management, clinical flowcharts), Labs/Prescriptions (eRX with CySCRIPT, EPCS, drug interaction checks), Telehealth (device integrations with Cardiocom, AMC, Qualcomm Life 2net), Patient Records/Interoperability (FHIR, DICOM, X.12, CCR, CDE, device data from smart watches, sonograms, EKGs), Custom Forms Builder.

Practice Management detail page. Medical Billing (clearinghouse, claims, A/R, charge ledger, exit billing, payer status), Appointment Scheduling (multi-provider/location, treatment programs, automated messaging), Medical Resource Management (supply chain, inventory for pharmaceuticals/supplies/equipment/gases/biohazard, RFID/barcode).

Occupational Health detail page. OSHA compliance: work-related injuries/illnesses records, hearing/other exams, annual injury summary data, 24-hour fatality notification, workplace medical records, recordkeeping/reporting. Adaptive forms, paper-to-digital conversion, multi-vector indexing.

Health Services Management detail page. Medical Evacuation (remote personnel), Medical Clearance for Travel, Travel Immunization (global map), Mental Health and Substance Abuse (separate from EHR per behavioral health regs).
Pharmacy Fulfillment detail page. Shipping (temperature-controlled), Inventory management, Barcodes for medication tracking and verification.
Contract Vehicles page. Lists GSA IT Schedule 70 (with Health SIN) for federal procurement.
Mandatory disclosures / ONC certification page. Wix-based, did not render readable content via WebFetch.

EMRFinder listing for CyCHART. Confirms cloud-based, web-based, features including e-prescribing, patient portal, clinical flowcharts, health risk assessment, chronic disease management, nutritional notes, drug interaction warnings, population health management, revenue cycle management. Target: solo/small practices, specialties: general practice, cardiology, podiatry, ophthalmology, pulmonology.

2018 press release on EHNAC CEAP accreditation. Confirms Arlington VA HQ, offices in San Antonio TX, Columbia MD, Ho Chi Minh Vietnam, Shanghai/Hangzhou China. CEO Terry Lin, VP Ops Elaine Law. Microsoft-based firm, 78 accreditation criteria met.

Business-Software.com review of CyMED. Confirms practice management features: automated proof of filing, payer status integration, real-time billing, claims manager for A/R, multi-provider/location scheduling, exit billing, EHNAC accredited clearinghouse, built-in EHR. Founded 2009, Arlington VA, SaaS.
PSI's About page on Hansen's Disease work. Wix-based, did not render content, but search snippets confirm Cyfluent is system of record for HRSA National Hansen's Disease Program on Azure FedRAMP.
PSI parent company health page. Wix-based, did not render. Search snippets confirm PSI designed/built/operates Cyfluent as cloud-native outpatient EHR for distributed clinical facilities.
Live CyPHR (Personal Health Record) portal login page. Confirms patient-facing portal exists as a separate web application.
